description: Land Acquisition - Aparekka, Devinuwara D/S Division, Matara District
categorisation: This gazette content is a land acquisition notice published under the Land Acquisition Act, declaring that specific parcels of land (Lots 6-196) are needed for public purpose and will be acquired. The document contains detailed descriptions of land boundaries, extents, and locations, along with references to current claimants. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) as it deals with land acquisition matters, which is a primary land and property-related administrative function.
